clips.title: The story
paras: In the southern Barrens, Doan Karhan sets warlocks to gather the scattered pieces of Soran'ruk. They seek to rebuild an orb that holds a disgraced demon's essence.

Failure within the Burning Legion brings an eternal sentence. When lesser demons lose favor with their masters, their spirits are bound inside crystal orbs. The Legion gives these prisons to mortal conjurers and warlocks as vessels for power under demonic control. Shattering an orb does not free its captive; even the shards hold potent magic.

Soran'ruk's orb lies in pieces across two continents. Twilight's Hammer cultists hold smaller fragments in the damp caverns of Blackfathom Deeps in Ashenvale. A sorcerer in the haunted ruins of Shadowfang Keep in Silverpine Forest claimed the larger, mostly intact half. Doan Karhan has spent his life studying Legion orbs and assembled the Orb of Zargain before. With the recovered pieces, he can restore Soran'ruk as a working implement.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: When demons of the Legion fall out of favor, their spirits are imprisoned within orbs and distributed to their mages and warlocks.
Many were carried by their servants in Azeroth. Even fragmented, they still possess the powers of the demons trapped inside.

The orb of Soran'ruk was broken into two pieces, one was further broken to be used by the acolytes of the Twilight's Hammer in Blackfathom Deeps. The other, larger piece, was possessed by a wizard in Shadowfang Keep. Find them and I can reform it.

clips.title: Progress
paras: It took me many years to collect the pieces of the orb of Zargain, but it has served me well, as I am sure the orb of Soran'ruk will serve you.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Yes... The orb was not greatly fragmented, and almost all of the pieces are here. It is a simple thing to recreate them, to make Soran'ruk whole again.

I have dedicated my life to the study of the Burning Legion's orbs and their recreation. You have done me a favor collecting these pieces to study, and I will give you them back—fully reconstructed—in a form of your choosing.
